name: Cheese Butter Masala
steps: Soak cashews in 100 ml hot water for 15 minutes and blend smooth with the soaking liquid. Keep cheese chilled until the sauce is ready so its cubes hold shape.
Melt half the butter in a heavy pan. Cook onion for 6 minutes until soft, add ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute, then pour in tomato puree.
Add chili powder and salt. Simmer 10 minutes, stirring, until the tomato tastes cooked and the sauce thickens; blend if desired for a smooth finish.
Stir in cashew paste and remaining water, then simmer 4 minutes. Add cream and crushed kasuri methi; reduce heat to very low.
Add cheese cubes and the remaining butter. Fold gently for just 1–2 minutes until the cheese begins to soften but does not melt away; serve at once.
tips: Use firm vegetarian cheese and add it only after the gravy is finished; soft cheese can disappear into the sauce.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
